correctness.rationale:
On D_beta with squared monomial weight (k+1)^(1-beta), the normalized basis is e_k=(k+1)^((beta-1)/2)z^k. The exact operator matrix for P(z) f^(n)(exp[-eps]z) has finite shifts j-n and entry p_j eps^n k!/(k-n)! exp[-eps(k-n)]((k+1)/(k-n+j+1))^((beta-1)/2). Compared to P(S)S*^n D_eps, the residual is O(eps) in operator norm and contributes negligible eps-scaled Schatten-q mass for every q>0. Closed-walk moments of the slowly varying finite-band Gram matrix lead to the two-variable symbol g(x)|P(e^{i theta})|, g=x^n exp[-x]. Uniform small-singular-value control via q

0, while localized plane waves establish the sharp spectral norm edge. Exact orthogonal monomial-column summation produces the Hilbert-Schmidt first correction eps^((2n)+1)||T_eps||^2 = [(2n)!/2^(2n+1)]A_P + eps[(2n-1)!/2^(2n)][n(n+beta)A_P-(beta-1)B_P]+o(eps). The finite-dimensional numerical tests separately corroborate the coefficient and are not a proof of infinite-rank asymptotics. Independently verified exact rational coefficients and numerically checked first-correction slopes for beta=0,1,3, n=1.
